about: Tertiary progression sign ingresses of the Sun and Moon, one day after birth for each tropical lunar month of life (27.32158 days), from the Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03 (Moshier, no files), same births and fixed now as progressions-swiss.json. last and next are lunar months after birth; lon is the tertiary longitude now. Written on 5 November 2026 by the same C reference program, with the age passed in months.
